350  {
351  if (state == 0 || state == 1)
352  return true;
353 
354  return (coreCStateMsr != NULL && state <= ((int)MAX_C_STATE) && coreCStateMsr[state] != 0);
355  }

358  bool isPackageCStateResidencySupported(int state)
359  {
360  return (pkgCStateMsr != NULL && state <= ((int)MAX_C_STATE) && pkgCStateMsr[state] != 0);

917  uint64 getQPILinksPerSocket() const
918  {
919  switch (cpu_model)
920  {
921  case NEHALEM_EP:
922  case WESTMERE_EP:
923  case CLARKDALE:
924  if (num_sockets == 2)
925  return 2;
926  else
927  return 1;
928  case NEHALEM_EX:
929  case WESTMERE_EX:
930  return 4;
931  case JAKETOWN:
932  case IVYTOWN:
933  case HASWELLX:
934  case BDX_DE:

1093  enum PCIeEventCode
1094  {
1095  // PCIe read events (PCI devices reading from memory - application writes to disk/network/PCIe device)
1096  PCIeRdCur = 0x19E, // PCIe read current (full cache line)
1097  PCIeNSRd = 0x1E4, // PCIe non-snoop read (full cache line)
1098  // PCIe write events (PCI devices writing to memory - application reads from disk/network/PCIe device)
1099  PCIeWiLF = 0x194, // PCIe Write (non-allocating) (full cache line)
1100  PCIeItoM = 0x19C, // PCIe Write (allocating) (full cache line)
1101  PCIeNSWr = 0x1E5, // PCIe Non-snoop write (partial cache line)
1102  PCIeNSWrF = 0x1E6, // PCIe Non-snoop write (full cache line)
1103  // events shared by CPU and IO
1104  RFO = 0x180, // Demand Data RFO; share the same code for CPU, use tid to filter PCIe only traffic
1105  CRd = 0x181, // Demand Code Read
1106  DRd = 0x182, // Demand Data Read
1107  PRd = 0x187, // Partial Reads (UC) (MMIO Read)
1108  WiL = 0x18F, // Write Invalidate Line - partial (MMIO write), PL: Not documented in HSX/IVT
1109  ItoM = 0x1C8, // Request Invalidate Line; share the same code for CPU, use tid to filter PCIe only traffic
1110 
1111  SKX_RFO = 0x200,
1112  SKX_CRd = 0x201,
1113  SKX_DRd = 0x202,
1114  SKX_PRd = 0x207,
1115  SKX_WiL = 0x20F,
1116  SKX_RdCur = 0x21E,
1117  SKX_ItoM = 0x248,
1118  };

1574 inline uint64 RDTSC()
1575 {
1576  uint64 result = 0;
1577 #ifdef _MSC_VER
1578  // Windows
1579  #if _MSC_VER>= 1600
1580  result = static_cast<uint64>(__rdtsc());
1581  #endif
1582 #else
1583  // Linux
1584  uint32 high = 0, low = 0;
1585  asm volatile("rdtsc" : "=a" (low), "=d" (high));
1586  result = low + (uint64(high)<<32ULL);
1587 #endif
1588  return result;
1589 
1590 }
1591 
1592 inline uint64 RDTSCP()
1593 {
1594  uint64 result = 0;
1595 #ifdef _MSC_VER
1596  // Windows
1597  #if _MSC_VER>= 1600
1598  unsigned int Aux;
1599  result = __rdtscp(&Aux);
1600  #endif
1601 #else
1602  // Linux and OS X
1603  uint32 high = 0, low = 0;
1604  asm volatile (
1605  "rdtscp\n\t"
1606  "mov %%edx, %0\n\t"
1607  "mov %%eax, %1\n\t":
1608  "=r" (high), "=r" (low) :: "%rax", "%rcx", "%rdx");
1609  result = low + (uint64(high)<<32ULL);
1610 #endif
1611  return result;
1612 }

1783 template <class CounterStateType>
1784 double getDRAMConsumedJoules(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
1785 {
1786  PCM * m = PCM::getInstance();
1787  if (!m) return -1.;
1788  double dram_joules_per_energy_unit;
1789 
1790  if (PCM::HASWELLX == m->getCPUModel()
1791  || PCM::BDX_DE == m->getCPUModel()
1792  || PCM::BDX == m->getCPUModel()
1793  || PCM::SKX == m->getCPUModel()
1794  || PCM::KNL == m->getCPUModel()
1795  ) {
1796 /* as described in sections 5.3.2 (DRAM_POWER_INFO) and 5.3.3 (DRAM_ENERGY_STATUS) of
1797  * Volume 2 (Registers) of
1798  * Intel Xeon E5-1600 v3 and Intel Xeon E5-2600 v3 (Haswell-EP) Datasheet (Ref 330784-001, Sept.2014)
1799  * ENERGY_UNIT for DRAM domain is fixed to 15.3 uJ for server HSX, BDW and KNL processors.
1800  */
1801  dram_joules_per_energy_unit = 0.0000153;
1802  } else {
1803 /* for all other processors (including Haswell client/mobile SKUs) the ENERGY_UNIT for DRAM domain
1804  * should be read from PACKAGE_POWER_SKU register (usually value around ~61uJ)
1805  */
1806  dram_joules_per_energy_unit = m->getJoulesPerEnergyUnit();
1807  }
1808  return double(getDRAMConsumedEnergy(before, after)) * dram_joules_per_energy_unit;
1809 }

2256 template <class CounterStateType>
2257 double getCyclesLostDueL3CacheMisses(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after) // 0.0 - 1.0
2258 {
2259  const int cpu_model = PCM::getInstance()->getCPUModel();
2260  if (cpu_model == PCM::ATOM || cpu_model == PCM::KNL) return -1;
2261  int64 clocks = after.CpuClkUnhaltedThread - before.CpuClkUnhaltedThread;
2262  if (clocks != 0)
2263  {
2264  return 180. * double(after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss) / double(clocks);
2265  }
2266  return -1;

2277 template <class CounterStateType>
2278 double getCyclesLostDueL2CacheMisses(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after) // 0.0 - 1.0
2279 {
2280  const int cpu_model = PCM::getInstance()->getCPUModel();
2281  if (cpu_model == PCM::ATOM || cpu_model == PCM::KNL || PCM::getInstance()->useSkylakeEvents()) return -1;
2282  int64 clocks = after.CpuClkUnhaltedThread - before.CpuClkUnhaltedThread;
2283  if (clocks != 0)
2284  {
2285  double L3UnsharedHit = (double)(after.L3UnsharedHit - before.L3UnsharedHit);
2286  double L2HitM = (double)(after.L2HitM - before.L2HitM);
2287  return (35. * L3UnsharedHit + 74. * L2HitM) / double(clocks);
2288  }
2289  return -1;
2290 }

2299 template <class CounterStateType>
2300 double getL2CacheHitRatio(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after) // 0.0 - 1.0
2301 {
2302  if (PCM::getInstance()->useSkylakeEvents()) {
2303  uint64 L2Hit = after.L2Hit - before.L2Hit;
2304  uint64 L2Ref = L2Hit + after.SKLL2Miss - before.SKLL2Miss;
2305  if (L2Ref) {
2306  return double(L2Hit) / double(L2Ref);
2307  }
2308  return 1;
2309  }
2310  const int cpu_model = PCM::getInstance()->getCPUModel();
2311  if (cpu_model == PCM::ATOM || cpu_model == PCM::KNL)
2312  {
2313  uint64 L2Miss = after.ArchLLCMiss - before.ArchLLCMiss;
2314  uint64 L2Ref = after.ArchLLCRef - before.ArchLLCRef;
2315  if (L2Ref) {
2316  return 1. - (double(L2Miss) / double(L2Ref));
2317  }
2318  return 1;
2319  }
2320  uint64 L3Miss = after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss;
2321  uint64 L3UnsharedHit = after.L3UnsharedHit - before.L3UnsharedHit;
2322  uint64 L2HitM = after.L2HitM - before.L2HitM;
2323  uint64 L2Hit = after.L2Hit - before.L2Hit;
2324  uint64 hits = L2Hit;
2325  uint64 all = L2Hit + L2HitM + L3UnsharedHit + L3Miss;
2326  if (all) return double(hits) / double(all);
2327 
2328  return 1;
2329 }
2330 
2338 template <class CounterStateType>
2339 double getL3CacheHitRatio(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after) // 0.0 - 1.0
2340 {
2341  if (!PCM::getInstance()->isL3CacheHitRatioAvailable()) return -1;
2342  if (PCM::getInstance()->useSkylakeEvents()) {
2343  uint64 L3Hit = after.SKLL3Hit - before.SKLL3Hit;
2344  uint64 L3Ref = L3Hit + after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss;
2345  if (L3Ref) {
2346  return double(L3Hit) / double(L3Ref);
2347  }
2348  return 1;
2349  }
2350 
2351  uint64 L3Miss = after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss;
2352  uint64 L3UnsharedHit = after.L3UnsharedHit - before.L3UnsharedHit;
2353  uint64 L2HitM = after.L2HitM - before.L2HitM;
2354  uint64 hits = L3UnsharedHit + L2HitM;
2355  uint64 all = L2HitM + L3UnsharedHit + L3Miss;
2356  if (all) return double(hits) / double(all);
2357 
2358  return 1;
2359 }

2368 template <class CounterStateType>
2369 uint64 getL3CacheMisses(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
2370 {

2372  return after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss;

2382 template <class CounterStateType>
2383 uint64 getL2CacheMisses(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
2384 {
2385  if (PCM::getInstance()->useSkylakeEvents()) {
2386  return after.SKLL2Miss - before.SKLL2Miss;
2387  }
2388  const int cpu_model = PCM::getInstance()->getCPUModel();
2389  if (cpu_model == PCM::ATOM || cpu_model == PCM::KNL)
2390  {
2391  return after.ArchLLCMiss - before.ArchLLCMiss;
2392  }
2393  uint64 L3Miss = after.L3Miss - before.L3Miss;
2394  uint64 L3UnsharedHit = after.L3UnsharedHit - before.L3UnsharedHit;
2395  uint64 L2HitM = after.L2HitM - before.L2HitM;
2396  return L2HitM + L3UnsharedHit + L3Miss;
2397 }

2406 template <class CounterStateType>
2407 uint64 getL2CacheHits(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
2408 {
2409  const int cpu_model = PCM::getInstance()->getCPUModel();

2517 template <class CounterStateType>
2518 inline double getCoreCStateResidency(int state, const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
2519 {
2520  const double tsc = double(getInvariantTSC(before, after));
2521 
2522  if (state == 0) return double(getRefCycles(before, after)) / tsc;
2523 
2524  if (state == 1)
2525  {
2526  PCM * m = PCM::getInstance();
2527  double result = 1.0 - double(getRefCycles(before, after)) / tsc; // 1.0 - cC0
2528  for (int i = 2; i <= PCM::MAX_C_STATE; ++i)
2529  if (m->isCoreCStateResidencySupported(state))
2530  result -= (after.BasicCounterState::CStateResidency[i] - before.BasicCounterState::CStateResidency[i]) / tsc;
2531 
2532  if (result < 0.) result = 0.; // fix counter dissynchronization
2533  else if (result > 1.) result = 1.; // fix counter dissynchronization
2534 
2535  return result;
2536  }
2537  return (after.BasicCounterState::CStateResidency[state] - before.BasicCounterState::CStateResidency[state]) / tsc;
2538 }

2652 inline uint64 getIncomingQPILinkBytes(uint32 socketNr, uint32 linkNr, const SystemCounterState & before, const SystemCounterState & after)
2653 {
2654  if (!PCM::getInstance()->incomingQPITrafficMetricsAvailable()) return 0;
2655  uint64 b = before.incomingQPIPackets[socketNr][linkNr];
2656  uint64 a = after.incomingQPIPackets[socketNr][linkNr];

2671 inline double getIncomingQPILinkUtilization(uint32 socketNr, uint32 linkNr, const SystemCounterState & before, const SystemCounterState & after)
2672 {
2673  PCM * m = PCM::getInstance();
2674  if (!(m->qpiUtilizationMetricsAvailable())) return 0.;
2675 
2676  const double bytes = (double)getIncomingQPILinkBytes(socketNr, linkNr, before, after);
2677  const uint64 max_speed = m->getQPILinkSpeed(socketNr, linkNr);
2678  const double max_bytes = (double)(double(max_speed) * double(getInvariantTSC(before, after) / double(m->getNumCores())) / double(m->getNominalFrequency()));
2679  return bytes / max_bytes;
2680 }
2681 
2692 inline double getOutgoingQPILinkUtilization(uint32 socketNr, uint32 linkNr, const SystemCounterState & before, const SystemCounterState & after)
2693 {
2694  PCM * m = PCM::getInstance();
2695 
2696  if (m->hasBecktonUncore())
2697  {
2698  const uint64 b = before.outgoingQPIFlits[socketNr][linkNr]; // idle flits
2699  const uint64 a = after.outgoingQPIFlits[socketNr][linkNr]; // idle flits
2700  // prevent overflows due to counter dissynchronisation
2701  const double idle_flits = (double)((a > b) ? (a - b) : 0);
2702  const uint64 bTSC = before.uncoreTSC;
2703  const uint64 aTSC = after.uncoreTSC;
2704  const double tsc = (double)((aTSC > bTSC) ? (aTSC - bTSC) : 0);
2705  if (idle_flits >= tsc) return 0.; // prevent oveflows due to potential counter dissynchronization
2706 
2707  return (1. - (idle_flits / tsc));
2708  } else if (m->hasPCICFGUncore())
2709  {
2710  const uint64 b = before.outgoingQPIFlits[socketNr][linkNr]; // data + non-data flits or idle (null) flits
2711  const uint64 a = after.outgoingQPIFlits[socketNr][linkNr]; // data + non-data flits or idle (null) flits
2712  // prevent overflows due to counter dissynchronisation
2713  double flits = (double)((a > b) ? (a - b) : 0);
2714  const double max_flits = ((double(getInvariantTSC(before, after)) * double(m->getQPILinkSpeed(socketNr, linkNr)) / m->getBytesPerFlit()) / double(m->getNominalFrequency())) / double(m->getNumCores());
2715  if(m->hasUPI())
2716  {
2717  flits = flits/3.;
2718  }
2719  if (flits > max_flits) return 1.; // prevent oveflows due to potential counter dissynchronization
2720  return (flits / max_flits);
2721  }
2722 
2723  return 0;
2724 }
2725 
2736 inline uint64 getOutgoingQPILinkBytes(uint32 socketNr, uint32 linkNr, const SystemCounterState & before, const SystemCounterState & after)
2737 {
2738  PCM * m = PCM::getInstance();
2739  if (!(m->outgoingQPITrafficMetricsAvailable())) return 0;
2740 
2741  const double util = getOutgoingQPILinkUtilization(socketNr, linkNr, before, after);
2742  const double max_bytes = (double(m->getQPILinkSpeed(socketNr, linkNr)) * double(getInvariantTSC(before, after) / double(m->getNumCores())) / double(m->getNominalFrequency()));
2743 
2744  return (uint64)(max_bytes * util);
2745 }

2872 template <class CounterStateType>
2873 inline double getLLCReadMissLatency(const CounterStateType & before, const CounterStateType & after)
2874 {
2875  const double occupancy = double(after.TOROccupancyIAMiss) - double(before.TOROccupancyIAMiss);
2876  const double inserts = double(after.TORInsertsIAMiss) - double(before.TORInsertsIAMiss);
2877  const double unc_clocks = double(after.UncClocks) - double(before.UncClocks);
2878  auto * m = PCM::getInstance();
2879  const double seconds = double(getInvariantTSC(before, after)) / double(m->getNumCores()/m->getNumSockets()) / double(m->getNominalFrequency());
2880  return 1e9*seconds*(occupancy/inserts)/unc_clocks;
2881 }
